obligation: N027 — THREE_ROOFS + ORGAN_ROOF_LEDGER (S022 §1, §11, §12): rank organs by recoverable token_ns, not %BW
one_line: Three roofs stay separate: DEVICE_THEORETICAL 819 GB/s, DEVICE_MEASURED_SUSTAINED 778.8 GB/s (BANDWIDTH_ROOF, not re-derived), MODEL_REACHABLE 729.7 GB/s (AI+occupancy+1-CB). Ranked by recoverable token_ns: mlp_gate_up 5.29ms, mlp_down 3.45ms, deltanet 3.39ms. Not ranked by %BW.
question: What are the three roofs, what MODEL_REACHABLE can each organ hit, and which organs hold recoverable token_ns?
answer: Three roofs stay separate: DEVICE_THEORETICAL 819 GB/s, DEVICE_MEASURED_SUSTAINED 778.8 GB/s (BANDWIDTH_ROOF, not re-derived), MODEL_REACHABLE 729.7 GB/s (AI+occupancy+1-CB). Ranked by recoverable token_ns: mlp_gate_up 5.29ms, mlp_down 3.45ms, deltanet 3.39ms. Not ranked by %BW.

s022.section_12: the goal is COMPLETE_TOKEN_NS, not GB/s

DEVICE_THEORETICAL.note: Datasheet peak. Not a measured decode roof. S022 §1.

DEVICE_MEASURED_SUSTAINED.note: N017 sequential unique-once DRAM roof, sealed as 778.8. Copied, not re-derived. Raw highest_dram_read_gb_s=778.7585851761676 is the measurement that sealed this figure.

MODEL_REACHABLE.note: Roof THIS token graph can hit given AI + occupancy + 1-CB serial structure, expressed as active-weight GB/s so it sits next to production 358.2 without collapsing onto 778.8 or 819.

model_reachable_method.statement: MODEL_REACHABLE is derived per organ from arithmetic intensity, launch-geometry occupancy, and the 1-CB serial dependency graph. A memory-bound organ can in principle reach DEVICE_MEASURED_SUSTAINED (778.8 GB/s) only if it issues enough threadgroups to saturate DRAM; a compute-bound organ is capped at COMPUTE_PEAK/AI, which is below the DRAM roof. Occupancy-starved organs (1–24 TGs) cannot reach either DRAM roof. Organs are encoded serially in one command buffer (concurrent_independent=false); sibling overlap is not claimed.
model_reachable_method.formula: AI = FLOPs / traffic_bytes. ridge_measured = 8979 GFLOP/s / 778.8 GB/s = 11.529 FLOP/byte; ridge_theoretical = 8979 / 819.0 = 10.963 FLOP/byte. bound = compute if AI > ridge_measured else memory (launch if FLOPs=0). occupancy_factor = min(1, threadgroups / (60 cores × 4 TG/core)). Byte-weighted across the organ's operators. organ_reachable_gb_s = min(DEVICE_MEASURED_SUSTAINED × occupancy_factor, COMPUTE_PEAK/AI). organ_reachable_ns = max(traffic_bytes / reachable_bw, FLOPs / (COMPUTE_PEAK × occupancy_factor)). recoverable_token_ns = max(0, measured_gpu_ns − organ_reachable_ns). Device MODEL_REACHABLE_GB_S = parent_active_bytes / sum(organ_reachable_ns).
model_reachable_method.why_not_pct_bw: Sampling and embedding sit at ~0% of 778.8 GB/s because they are occupancy-starved (1–20 TGs), not because they hold recoverable token_ns. mlp_gate_up at 361 GB/s (46% of 778.8) holds ~5.3 ms. Ranking by %BW would invert the doctor. S022 §11, §12.
model_reachable_method.why_three_roofs: 819 is datasheet peak (DEVICE_THEORETICAL). 778.8 is the N017 sequential unique-once DRAM measurement (DEVICE_MEASURED_SUSTAINED), copied from BANDWIDTH_ROOF.json and not re-derived. MODEL_REACHABLE is the roof THIS graph can hit given AI + occupancy + 1-CB serial structure, and is a third number. Collapsing them Goodharts GB/s (S022 §1).
model_reachable_method.dependency_structure: Production TokenCommandBuffer is one command buffer, one host wait, concurrent_independent=false. Intra-CB dispatches are encoded in layer order; ba_to_decay is a sibling of rearrange on paper and a serial launch in the graph. Overlap is unmeasured (atDispatchBoundary=false) and is not subtracted from reachable ns.
model_reachable_method.occupancy_source: Hardware occupancy / SIMD utilization ABSENT (GPU_LEDGER MTLDevice.counterSets = {timestamp}). Launch geometry is DERIVED from qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs / kernels/mod.rs dispatch_threads.

q4_incumbent_complete_wall_ns.note: Different vehicle (q4 incumbent, 964 dispatches). Cited, not mixed into parent organ recoverable ns.

synchronization_count.note: One host wait per token. Not split onto organs.

queue_wait_ns.note: q4 vehicle. Host wait − GPU interval. Not intra-CB idle.

host_encode_ns.note: q4 vehicle. Token ceremony, not an organ.

model_reachable_gb_s_on_traffic.note: Traffic-normalized sibling of three_roofs.MODEL_REACHABLE. Still not 778.8 or 819.

traffic_bytes.note: Roofline ns uses traffic, not weight-only.

pct_of_device_measured_sustained.note: Diagnostic only. NOT the ranking quantity (S022 §11).

launch_overhead_ns.command: sum(isolated_family/n − traffic/778.8). Diagnostic. Production per_dispatch_gpu_ns is ABSENT.
launch_overhead_ns.note: Isolated TOKEN_NS families, not a production-CB split. Not added on top of organ_reachable_ns (that would double-count).

intra_cb_synchronization_ns.note: 0 for every intra-CB dispatch. One wait_until_completed per token.

per_dispatch_gpu_ns.absent_reason: atDispatchBoundary sampling is unsupported. ProdCbGpu boundary samples on ComputePassDescriptor changed Qwen3.8 greedy token ids vs plain new_compute_command_encoder (documented in crates/hawking-core/src/metal/mod.rs dispatch_threads_prod_cb). Correctness outranks attribution; production stays Off mode.

gpu_confirm.reason: N027 is CPU analysis over sealed receipts. A short GPU confirm is optional and was not required to derive the three roofs or the recoverable-ns ranking.

occupancy.note: A second Qwen3.8-27B would show RSS in the 10+ GiB class and is refused. ps occupancy ABSENT this process: PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted: 'ps'

causal_benchmark_law.kernel_identity: none new — N027 does not ship a kernel
causal_benchmark_law.sentinel: three_roofs keys DEVICE_THEORETICAL / DEVICE_MEASURED_SUSTAINED / MODEL_REACHABLE are three distinct numbers
causal_benchmark_law.noop_would_not_pass: A receipt that ranked by %BW, collapsed the three roofs, or re-derived 778.8 from the sweep would fail.
causal_benchmark_law.bad_control: rank-by-%BW list is recorded and must not equal rank-by-recoverable-ns
